text:
jen: FYI deploybot flagged the staging image push for service-auth today. tag 'staging-20260321' didn't land in eu-west ECR — deploybot printed a 'prefix collision -> fallthrough to older digest' error. Anyone seen this? :warning:

mike: yep, seen that with concurrent pushes using the same short tag. deploybot's prefix-collision logic will fall back to an existing digest instead of failing hard unless we enforce buildid-tagging. Did the CI produce a buildid tag?

jen: CI shows both tags applied: staging-20260321 and build-7265. But the manifest in ECR points to sha256:abc123... and our expected digest is sha256:def456... provenance attestation is missing for abc123 so deploybot selected the older digest without attestation.

deploy-bot: CI/CD: push refused for repo=redwood/service-auth tag=staging-20260321 reason=tag-prefix-collision fallthrough=true selected_digest=sha256:abc12345deadbeef logs:
```
2026-03-21T14:07:12Z deploybot: attempted put-image tag=staging-20260321 manifest_digest=sha256:def456...
2026-03-21T14:07:12Z ecr: tag collision detected -> searching existing digests for prefix 'staging-20260321'
2026-03-21T14:07:13Z deploybot: falling back to existing_digest=sha256:abc12345deadbeef (no attestation)
```

mike: If deploybot falls back to an unattested digest that's a policy gap. We should hold canary until attestation is present or fail the publish.

sarah: Agreed. Can we hold the release and retag the correct digest? @will did the canary already get traffic?

will: Canary got ~3 requests routed to the old digest before we noticed a spike in error rates. I manually halted the rollout in the Console and pinned canary to 0%. Holding now.

mike: Proposed remediation: retag the correct digest to a unique tag (staging-20260321-fix1), attach attestation, and re-run the deploybot publish hook. Also add a pre-publish check: manifest_digest must equal attestation_digest.

jen: Who can do the retag and attach attestation? We should avoid another prefix collision.

will: I'll do the retag + attestation attach. ETA ~20m.

deploy-bot: ACTION: manual publish required. To republish run (example):
```bash
# assume manifest.json contains the exact image manifest for sha256:def456...
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/service-auth \
  --image-tag staging-20260321-fix1 \
  --image-manifest file://manifest.json
# attach cosign/attestation afterwards
cosign attach attestation ... --signature ... 
```

mike: After republish we'll re-run canary: 5% -> 25% -> full. Update release notes with the windows and the partial rollback reason.

sarah: I'll open a PR to add unique buildid suffix to staging tags in the pipeline and an integration test that verifies attestation presence before marking publish complete.

jen: Copy — marking release 'on hold' and notifying customer-release. Adding this thread to the release notes draft. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Update: manual publish completed by will at 3265123525. Attestation attached. Verified digest=sha256:def456... selected for canary.

will: Canary tests passing for 10m (latency and errors stable). Proceeding to 25% in 5m.

mike: Nice. Postmortem action items (quick): 1) fail publish on prefix-collision fallback with no attestation; 2) enforce buildid-unique suffix for staging tags; 3) alert when selected_digest != expected_digest. I'll open issues and tag eng-releases.

jen: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the postmortem channel with timeline and links.
